recipes.title: Roast beef tenderloin in sour cream sauce - Svíčková
recipes.titleEnglish: Roast beef tenderloin in sour cream sauce
ingredients: 2 cups sliced soup greens (carrots, parsnips, celery root)
few grains allspice, whole black pepper, thyme, bay leaves, nutmeg
instructions: Tenderloin must be aged and all the fat trimmed off. Cut small slits along the grain of the meat and stuff them with thin strips of bacon. Salt and pepper the meat and set aside.
In a large frying pan combine the oil, half of the sliced soup greens and the onion; place the roast on top and brown on all sides.

In the meantime preheat the oven to 350F. Transfer the roast and the vegetables into a roasting pan, add the remaining vegetables and spices. Roast 40-45 minutes, basting with beef stock and juices from the pan. Remove the roast, keep it warm. Pour the pan drippings into a large stewpan, skim the fat, set pan over medium heat and deglaze, using stock or water. Add the flour, simmer five minutes. Place the roast in the sauce, add the lemon juice and simmer until the meat becomes tender on the outside (20 minutes).
Strain the sauce, discard the spices, mash the vegetables and mix them into the sauce. Blend in the sour cream and simmer for a few minutes. The sauce should be medium thick.
Slice the roast, pour some sauce over it and serve the remainder in a sauce dish.

It is important that you make enough sauce, adding beef stock and sour cream. Taste it and add salt, pepper, lemon juice – if needed. The taste should be mildly piquant. The typical accompaniment is crouton or yeast dumplings, or noodles.
notes: Alternative – Lard the tenderloin, grease a roasting pan with oil, cover the bottom of the pan with the vegetables, lay the roast on top, add more vegetables, spices and lemon juice. Add the remaining oil, cover and marinate overnight. Next day prepare the roast as indicated above.

If planning to prepare a larger quantity, for example a whole tenderloin, increase all ingredients accordingly. Instead of browning the roast by frying, roast it on all sides in a hot oven (475F), then lower the temperature to 350F and proceed as shown above.

recipes.title: Beef tenderloin slices (shortcut for “svíčková”) · Řezy ze svíčkové
ingredients: chopped parsley, thyme, marjoram, lemon rind
1·1/2 cups chicken or beef stock, or water
instructions: Cut the tenderloin into 1” thick slices. Pound each slice with the palm of your hand and lard with half slice bacon each. Salt and pepper them lightly and fry in hot oil about 2·1/2 minutes on each side. Place them in a casserole, keep them warm.

In a saucepan combine melted butter, onion, pickles, anchovies, parsley, capers, lemon rind, marjoram and thyme and brown all. Add flour, brown a little more. Add stock or water, sour cream. Simmer for five minutes, strain and pour over the meat slices. Simmer until heated through.
Serve with dumplings, gnocchi, rice, noodles.

recipes.title: Beef croquettes · Karbanátky
instructions: Soak the rolls in water, squeeze off excess liquid, shred them. Blend them with the ground meat, egg, chopped onion, diced bacon, salt, pepper and marjoram.
Form 12 hamburgers, coat them with bread crumbs and fry on both sides.
Instead of frying, they can be roasted in the oven, basting them with hot oil, their own juices, chicken or beef stock, or water.
Serve with mashed potatoes and salad. Or serve cold with dark bread, potato salad, or pickles.

recipes.title: Stuffed meat loaf · Svíčková sekaná plněná
ingredients: 1·1/2 lbs. ground sirloin or chuck (ground pork shoulder can substitute half of the ground beef)
instructions: Soak the rolls in water, squeeze off excess liquid, shred them and mix well with the ground meat. Add diced bacon, egg, salt, pepper, marjoram, chopped onion, 1 tablespoon water and mix it very well. If the mixture is not thick enough, add 1-2 tablespoons bread crumbs.

Turn the mixture over onto a board dusted with bread crumbs. Form a 3/4” thick rectangle. Arrange hard boiled eggs and peeled and diced pickles by longer side of the rectangle. Roll the meat mixture over the eggs and form a loaf. Grease baking tray with oil, sprinkle the remaining oil over the loaf, and bake at 350F for one hour. Baste with chicken stock and juices from the pan. When done, slice the loaf on a serving dish, sprinkle with pan drippings.
Serve with vegetables, mashed potatoes, boiled potatoes, potato salad, etc.

recipes.title: Beef goulash · Guláš z hovězího masa
ingredients: 3·4 lbs. boneless beef stew meat (bottom round, rump, chuck), cut in 1·1/2” cubes
3 slices bacon cut in short strips
1/2 teaspoon each of caraway seeds and marjoram
instructions: Heat oil in a large stewpan. Add bacon and onion. Cook slowly, stirring and turning frequently until bacon is lightly browned and onion is translucent. Add beef. Sprinkle evenly over the meat: caraway seeds, marjoram, paprika, garlic. Cover, simmer one hour over low heat adding occasionally 2·3 tablespoons beef stock or water, if needed. Liquid in the pan should be just enough so that the onion and the meat do not burn or stick to the pan.

When meat is half done, uncover pan and let cooking liquid nearly evaporate. Sprinkle flour over meat and braise 2·3 minutes. Add enough beef stock or water to cover the meat. Simmer 30 minutes or until meat is tender. Should the sauce be too thick, add some more beef stock or water.
Taste sauce, season with salt and pepper. Lift meat onto a warmed deep serving dish. Strain sauce and pour over meat. Serve with boiled potatoes, rice, salad.
notes: Alternative 1 – Prepare beef goulash as shown above. Peel and slice 4 pickled cucumbers, add to the goulash, heat through, serve.
Alternative 2 – Turn the goulash over into a deep serving dish, sprinkle with shredded ham and grated Parmesan cheese. Serve with white rice.

recipes.title: Bohemian “brasciole” - stuffed beef (veal) rolls · Hovězí (telecí) závitky
yieldTime: Serves 6 – Preparation time: 1 hour, plus marinating
ingredients: 6 thin, approx. 1/4”, slices beef sirloin (or veal top round)
instructions: Pound the meat slices and salt them on both sides. In a skillet, combine the butter and finely chopped onion. Brown the onion lightly, then add sliced mushrooms and lemon juice. Sauté 6-8 minutes. Discard the fat. Blend in two egg yolks, spice with salt and pepper. Spread the mixture evenly over the meat slices, roll each to enclose mixture, wrap each roll with a slice of bacon. Tie them with a string or fasten with wooden picks or small skewers. Place them in a container.
Mix wine, olive oil, Worcestershire sauce and pressed garlic and pour over the meat rolls. Let them marinate for 4 hours or overnight in a refrigerator.

On stove top heat a large heavy skillet. Add the rolls and brown them on all sides for about 20 minutes frequently adding some of the marinate. Remove the string, wooden picks or skewers. Serve with fried potatoes, vegetables, salad.

recipes.title: Roast veal · Telecí pečeně
ingredients: 3·4 lbs. leg of veal or top round, boned
instructions: Lard the veal with strips of bacon. Rub it with salt and pepper. In a casserole combine the butter, chopped onion and the roast. Brown it lightly. Pour the cognac over and ignite it. When the flame dies down add the wine, sliced carrots, thyme, snipped parsley, crushed bay leaves, some of the chicken stock, and roast at 350F for 2 hours, basting occasionally with pan juices and chicken stock. Slice the roast. Strain pan juices into a saucepan, add 1/2 tablespoon butter and more chicken stock if needed; bring to boil. Serve sauce over sliced meat or on side. Serve with vegetables, noodles, boiled potatoes.

recipes.title: Stuffed veal breast · Telecí hrudí nadívané
instructions: Rinse the meat and pat it dry with a paper towel. Using the handle of a wooden spoon, make an opening in the narrower end of the veal breast to form a cavity for stuffing. Most supermarkets sell the veal breast ready to be stuffed.

Salt the meat and lightly fill the cavity with stuffing. Enclose it with stitches, or use a skewer. Lay the stuffed veal breast in a roasting pan with rack, skin down. Pour some of the melted butter on top and roast at 350F for 45 minutes. Turn it and roast 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until golden on top.
Baste occasionally with melted butter and pan drippings.
Prick the stuffed cavity with fork several times to let out the steam. (The steam would push out the stuffing while slicing it). Remove the stitches or skewer.
Let it stand 5 minutes. Slice and sprinkle with juices from the pan. Serve with boiled potatoes, vegetables, salad, compote.
In a frying pan combine melted butter and lightly beaten eggs. Scramble until the egg whites stiffen. Blend in ham and green peas. Salt.

Soak the rolls in milk, squeeze off excess, shred them. In a bowl cream the butter, whisk in the egg and the egg yolk. Add all remaining ingredients, leaving the bread crumbs to be added last. If the stuffing is thick enough, do not use up all bread crumbs. This stuffing may also be used for roasted stuffed chicken, pigeon, etc.
Soak the rolls in milk, squeeze off excess, shred them. Grind the liver, or mash it with a knife. Cream the butter, and blend in thoroughly all ingredients.

recipes.title: Veal chops with caraway seeds · Telecí žebírka na kmíně
instructions: Pound the veal chops lightly-they should not be more than 1/2” thick. Make a few short cuts on the edges to prevent curling, salt them on both sides, and dust with flour on one side. Brown chops in hot oil on both sides, floured side first. In a skillet combine the butter and finely chopped onion and set over medium heat.
When the onion becomes translucent add the caraway seeds, some of the chicken stock and the veal chops and simmer about 30 minutes or until the chops are tender.

Remove the veal chops. Bring the liquid to boil, blend in flour and remaining stock, and boil until the sauce thickens (about 5 minutes). Strain the sauce over the veal chops, simmer 5 minutes. Serve with noodles, rice, salad.

recipes.title: Breaded veal chops · Telecí žebírka smažená
instructions: Pound the veal chops. Make a few short cuts on the edges to prevent curling, salt them on both sides. Dip each in milk, dredge in flour shaking off excess, then dip in beaten eggs and coat with bread crumbs.
Fry in hot oil in a covered pan for 5 minutes, turn them and finish frying uncovered. Drain on paper towel. Serve with potato salad, mashed potatoes, green vegetables, salad.

recipes.title: Wiener Schnitzel · Breaded veal scallops · Řízky
ingredients: 6 veal scallops – leg of veal or veal top round, thin sliced
instructions: Pound the scallops. Make a few short cuts on the edges to prevent curling, salt them on both sides. Dredge them in flour, shake off excess, dip in beaten eggs and coat with bread crumbs. Fry in hot oil in a covered pan about 4 minutes or until golden brown; turn and fry the other side uncovered. Drain on paper towel. Serve with potatoes, potato salad, mashed potatoes, green salad.
notes: This is the correct way to prepare Wiener Schnitzels, a very popular meal in Bohemia. Thinly sliced boneless pork chops, beef tenderloin slices, boned and skinned chicken breast or cutlets may be prepared in the same manner.

recipes.title: Veal goulash · Guláš telecí
ingredients: 3 lbs. boneless veal shoulder, cut in 1” cubes
instructions: Melt butter in a heavy 3 quart saucepan. Add onion and cook over medium heat until translucent. Add paprika, curry, veal, 2·3 tablespoons chicken broth.

Simmer over low heat about 1 hr. adding gradually chicken broth, if needed. The meat must be simmering in just enough liquid so that it does not stick to the pot. You may not use up all of the chicken broth. When the veal is tender, not overcooked, add lemon juice. Mix well flour and cream and blend the mixture into the stew. Bring to boil, simmer 5 minutes, stirring often. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Serve with dumplings, noodles, salad.

recipes.title: Pork roast · Vepřová pečeně
ingredients: 3·4 lbs. center cut pork roast – (ask the butcher to saw across the rib bones of the roast, at the base of the backbone – separating the ribs from the backbone. It will ease the carving).
instructions: In a saucepan heat the chicken stock, caraway seeds, bay leaves and garlic.

Rinse and pat dry the meat and rub it with salt and pepper. Place it, skin down, on a rack in an open roasting pan. Pour half of the liquid from the saucepan over the meat and roast at 350F for 1 hour, basting frequently with the juices from the pan and the liquid from the saucepan. Turn the meat and continue roasting for 1·1/2 hours, until the top is golden brown and the meat tender. Allow 35 minutes per pound.
When done let it rest 5 minutes, carve.
Skim fat from the pan drippings, strain some over the roast, serve the rest in a saucedish.
Serve with dumplings, potato dumplings, boiled potatoes and sauerkraut.

recipes.title: Fresh ham in cream sauce · Vepřová kýta na smetaně
ingredients: 3·4 lbs. fresh ham, boned and skinned
3 bay leaves, thyme, whole allspice, whole black pepper
instructions: Dice the carrots, celery root and parsnip. Cut the bacon into short strips.
Skim off fat from the meat, rinse and pat it dry, salt it and lard with bacon strips.
In a large stewpot combine melted butter, vegetables, spices, lemon rind, grated or chopped.
Set over medium heat. Add the meat and brown it lightly on all sides. Lower the heat, cover tightly and simmer over low heat until tender, about 2 hours, gradually adding the chicken stock or water.
Remove meat from pot, keep it warm.
Strain the gravy into a saucepan. Combine flour and sour cream and blend it into the gravy. Add lemon juice, simmer 5 minutes.
Slice meat, pour the gravy over it or serve separately.
Serve with dumplings, noodles, vegetables.

recipes.title: Pork chops with caraway seeds · Vepřová žebírka na kmíně
instructions: Pound the pork chops lightly·they should not be more than 1/2" thick. Make a few short cuts on the edges to prevent curling, salt them on both sides and dust with flour on one side. Brown chops in hot oil, floured side first.
In a large skillet combine the butter and finely chopped onion and set over medium heat.
When the onion becomes translucent, add caraway seeds and some of the chicken stock. Add the pork chops and simmer about 30 minutes or until they are tender.
Remove the chops, bring the liquid to boil, blend in flour and chicken stock and simmer until the sauce thickens. The sauce should be medium thick. Strain.
Return pork chops in the sauce, simmer until heated through.
Serve with boiled potatoes, rice, salad.

recipes.title: Breaded pork chops · Vepřová žebírka smažená
ingredients: 6 pork loin rib chops, cut about 1/2" thick
instructions: Pound the pork chops lightly; make a few short cuts on the edges to prevent curling.
Spice them with salt and pepper. Dredge them in flour shaking off excess, dip in beaten eggs and coat with bread crumbs.
Fry the chops in a covered pan for 5 minutes, turn them and finish frying uncovered. Drain on paper towel.
Serve with potato salad, green salad, vegetables.

recipes.title: Smoked pork loin · Uzené vepřové maso
ingredients: 2·3 lbs. fully cooked smoked pork loin or shoulder
instructions: Place meat in boiling water and simmer until thoroughly heated.
About 30 minutes. To serve, cut meat into slices.
Serve with boiled potatoes and sauerkraut, mashed potatoes, vegetables, poached apples, salad.

recipes.title: Pork goulash · Guláš vepřový
ingredients: 3 lbs. boned pork shoulder, cut in 1·1/2" cubes
instructions: Sauté onion in oil. Add paprika, vinegar, pork, caraway seeds, pepper, few spoons of beef stock. Cover and simmer 1·1/2 hrs, or until meat is tender. Stir occasionally and gradually add beef stock, little at a time, just enough to keep moisture in the stew.
Blend flour, sour cream and 1/2 cup beef stock. Stir the mixture in the pan with the meat. Simmer 10·15 minutes. If the sauce is too thick, add more beef stock.
Taste for salt. Should you prefer to redden the color of the sauce, add 2·3 tablespoons tomato paste.
Serve with potatoes or dumplings.

recipes.title: Goulash with sauerkraut · Guláš s kyselým zelím
ingredients: 3 lbs. boned pork shoulder, cut in 1·1/2" cubes
1 large raw potato, peeled, grated or finely sliced,
instructions: Sauté onion in oil until translucent. Sprinkle paprika evenly over onion, add pork, vinegar, caraway seeds, salt and pepper, 1/4 cup water. Cover and simmer until meat is almost tender, about 1 hr. 15 minutes. Occasionally add 1·2 tablespoons water, just enough to keep moisture in the stew. Stir and turn pork after each addition.
Stir sauerkraut into the goulash, blend in cream and potato. Simmer 10·15 minutes, or until meat is tender. Add salt, pepper and more paprika if desired.
Serve with crouton dumplings, boiled potatoes.

recipes.title: Leg of lamb in wine sauce · Skopová kýta dušená
recipes.titleEnglish: Leg of lamb in wine sauce
ingredients: 3·4 lbs. lamb leg, boned, skinned (4·5 lbs. with bone)
1/2 teaspoon each of ginger and ground nutmeg
3 bay leaves, whole allspice, whole black pepper
instructions: Slice thinly parsnip, carrots, celery root and onion.
Cut the bacon into short strips.
Trim off excess fat from the meat, lard it with bacon (= make small slits in roast and push a strip of bacon into each slit).
Mix salt, pepper, ginger, nutmeg. Rub over lamb.
Heat the oil in a large stewpot, add the sliced vegetables, cook five minutes.
Place the lamb in the pot, brown it lightly, sprinkle with the remaining spices.
Cover and simmer 1 hour, gradually adding chicken stock.
Remove the lamb.
Spoon fat from the juices, stir in flour and cook until lightly browned.
Blend in lemon juice, cranberry juice, wine, chicken stock.
Return lamb to the mixture, cover and simmer until tender for about 1 hour.
Place lamb on a warm serving platter, garnish with mint, cranberries, snipped parsley, chestnuts.
Strain the sauce, heat thoroughly, serve in a saucedish.
Serve with rice, noodles, vegetables, potatoes.

recipes.title: Leg of lamb in cream sauce · Skopová kýta na smetaně
recipes.titleEnglish: Leg of lamb in cream sauce
instructions: At the time of adding lemon juice, cranberry juice and red wine, substitute 1 cup sour cream for chicken stock.

recipes.title: Mutton goulash · Guláš skopový
ingredients: 3 lbs. boned shoulder of mutton, cut in pieces, about 1·1/2"
1 teaspoon each of caraway seeds and marjoram
instructions: Serve with potatoes, gnocchi, etc.

recipes.title: Roast chicken · Kuře pečené
instructions: Rinse and pat dry the chicken; season with salt and pepper. Place it on rack in a shallow roasting pan, breast down. Melt the butter and sprinkle some over the chicken. Pour half of the chicken stock into a roasting pan. Cook 30 minutes in 350F oven.

Turn chicken breast up, lay bacon slices on top and continue baking 30·40 minutes until golden brown on top. Baste occasionally with the remaining butter and chicken stock, juices from the pan, or water.
Let stand 5 minutes before cutting into serving portions.
Serve with mashed potatoes, vegetables, salad, compote, mushrooms.

recipes.title: Breaded chicken · Smažené kuře
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chicken, 4·5 lbs., cut in serving pieces or
instructions: Rinse and pat dry chicken pieces, salt them lightly. Dredge each piece in flour, shake off excess, dip in beaten eggs with a little salt added and coat with bread crumbs. Fry in hot oil until golden, about 5 minutes each side. Drain on paper towel.
Serve on lettuce-lined platter, garnish with lemon wedges and parsley.
Serve with potato salad, green salad, mashed potatoes, vegetables.

recipes.title: Chicken paprika · Kuře na paprice
ingredients: 1 chicken, 4·5 lbs., cut up into small serving portions or
instructions: In a large heavy skillet sauté onion in butter until translucent. Stir in paprika and vinegar. Lay chicken pieces on top, cover, and simmer until almost tender, about 20 minutes. Gradually add chicken broth, if needed. Cooking liquid should be just enough that onion and chicken do not burn.
Using a slotted spoon remove chicken pieces.
Blend flour and sour cream, stir into liquid in pan, and add remaining chicken broth. Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring often.
Return chicken to pan, simmer until tender but not overcooked, 5·10 minutes.
Season to taste with salt and pepper. Sauce should be medium thick and mildly piquant.
Serve with rice, noodles, gnocchi, salad.

recipes.title: Chicken ragoût · Ragoût z kuřete
ingredients: 2 lbs. chicken breast, boned, skin removed
2 tablespoons butter and 3 tablespoons flour for the roux.
instructions: Cook chicken and soup vegetables in lightly salted boiling water. When cool enough to handle, dice the chicken, discard soup vegetables, reserve the broth. While the chicken cooks, heat 2 tablespoons butter in a skillet and sauté the mushrooms over medium heat (about 4 minutes) – must not be too soft. Remove from heat and reserve. Cook cauliflower in lightly salted boiling water – do not overcook, must be tender, not mushy. Drain and separate in rosettes. Reserve. In a large skillet melt the remaining 2 tablespoons butter, add 3 tablespoons flour and stir over low/medium heat until golden brown. Add 1·1/2 cups of the reserved chicken broth and simmer, uncovered, until the mixture thickens, 5·10 minutes. Add juice of 1 lemon, diced chicken, simmer 2 minutes. Blend in egg yolks, mushrooms and cauliflower rosettes. Season to taste with salt, pepper, more lemon juice. If the ragoût is too thick, add a little more chicken broth. Serve as is with boiled potatoes, lettuce.

Transfer the mixture into a buttered gratin dish, or casserole, top with grated Parmesan and bread crumbs. Sprinkle with melted butter. Bake in hot oven (400F), 10·15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown. Serve with french bread, bread sticks, lettuce.

recipes.title: Chicken ragoût on a half shell · as an appetizer · Ragoût na mušlích
recipes.titleEnglish: Chicken ragoût on a half shell
instructions: Butter the shells, fill each little over half full with chicken ragoût, sprinkle with grated Parmesan, bread crumbs and melted butter. Bake at 400F about 15 minutes or until golden on top.

recipes.title: Roast turkey · Krocan pečený
instructions: Rinse turkey with cold water, and pat dry inside and out with paper towel.
Rub the body and neck cavities with salt and butter. Brush skin with butter.
Preheat oven to 350F.
Pour one cup chicken broth in a roasting pan. Place the bird in the pan, breast down. Roast, uncovered 1·1/2 hours, basting occasionally with butter, chicken broth and pan drippings.
Turn turkey breast up, place 2 slices bacon on top and roast 1·1/2 – 2 hours, basting with the remaining butter, chicken broth and juices from the pan.

When done, transfer the bird on a heated platter. Strain the pan drippings, discarding all fat, and pour some over the turkey. Serve the remaining juice in a saucedish. For easier carving allow turkey to stand 10·15 minutes.
Serve with potatoes, salad, vegetables, compote.

recipes.title: Stuffed turkey · Krocan nadívaný
instructions: Prepare the bird as indicated in “roast turkey”. Turn the neck into the body cavity to block the passage between the neck and the body. The stuffing will stay in the neck cavity while roasting. Lightly fill neck cavity with stuffing. Do not pack · stuffing will expand while cooking. Fasten neck skin with stitches or skewer. Roast turkey as shown above.
Soak the rolls in milk or water, squeeze off excess liquid, shred them. Rinse and finely chop the giblets.
In a bowl cream butter, eggs, add the chopped onion, thyme, marjoram, shredded rolls, giblets, bread crumbs. Salt the mixture and mix thoroughly.
Simmer chestnuts in water for 10·15 minutes. When the shells crack, peel and chop them coarsely.

Break the rolls, soak them in milk, squeeze off excess, shred them. In a bowl cream butter, one whole egg and three egg yolks. Add the shredded rolls, nutmeg, sugar and coarsely chopped chestnuts. Salt the mixture; Fold in half of the bread crumbs and three stiffly whipped egg whites.

Turn the stuffing into a fluted tube pan or a flan ring, buttered and dusted with bread crumbs. Bake in a bain-marie at 350F for 1·1/2 hours. When done, let it stand 5 minutes, then invert on a serving dish. Slice it like a cake.
Serve with apricot or pear compote, cranberries, etc.
Break the rolls and soak them in milk. Squeeze off excess, shred and strain them.
In a bowl cream butter, egg yolks and sugar. Combine all ingredients. Fold in three stiffly beaten egg whites.
Bake and serve in the same manner as chestnut stuffing.
Same as almond stuffing, replacing half of the almonds with 3/4 cup golden raisins.
notes: (Have chestnuts ready ahead of time. Bake stuffing while roasting turkey, so that both will be done at the same time).

recipes.title: Stuffed pigeon · Holub nadívaný
ingredients: 4 and 2 tablespoons butter (2. tbsp for braising the liver)
instructions: Soak the rolls in milk, squeeze off excess, shred them. Cream the butter and the egg yolks, add the shredded rolls, the liver sautéed in butter, salt, snipped parsley, bread crumbs. Add stiffly whipped egg white.
Carefully loosen the skin of the breasts and fill the pockets with stuffing. Enclose with stitches.
Salt the pigeons. Place them in a roasting pan with melted butter, breasts down, roast at 350F for 20 minutes.
Baste with melted butter, juices from the pan and a little chicken stock.
Turn pigeons breasts up and finish roasting in the same manner.
To serve, cut the pigeons in halves, sprinkle with pan drippings and snipped parsley. (Remove the stitches, of course).
Serve with potatoes, green peas, salad, etc.

recipes.title: Roast goose · Husa pečená
instructions: Rinse goose, pat dry. Rinse the apples-do not peel them. Rub the goose inside and out with salt and caraway seeds. Fill body cavity with apples.
Place goose in a roasting pan with a little hot water at the bottom.

Roast at 350F, first breast side down for 1·1/2 hrs, basting with water and pan drippings. When golden brown on top, turn goose breast side up. Continue roasting for 1-1/2 hours. While roasting, prick the skin with a fork over the fatty areas to release fat. (Just the skin, not the meat. If the juice from the meat runs out, the goose will become dry.) Total roasting time is approximately 20 minutes per pound. During the last 15 minutes of roasting, raise oven temperature to 400F and stop basting to achieve a crunchy skin. Remove apples and slice goose. Skim fat from pan juices and pour into a gravy boat to accompany goose. Serve with dumplings, potato dumplings, cabbage, red cabbage, sauerkraut.

recipes.title: Roast duck · Kachna pečená
instructions: Roast the duck in the same manner as the goose. Do not stuff with apples. While roasting, baste often with butter.

recipes.title: Duckling with Madeira wine · Kachna na víně
instructions: Rinse duckling, pat dry. Sprinkle with salt and pepper inside and out. Melt butter in a roasting pan, add ham and duckling. Brown it quickly on both sides under the broiler. Lower oven temperature to 350F. Pour Madeira wine over duckling. Add some of the chicken stock, salt and pepper, and cover with buttered waxpaper. Roast 1 to 1·1/2 hours, occasionally adding the remaining chicken stock.
Transfer duckling to a heated platter. Skim fat from pan drippings and strain into a saucepan. Add flour and slowly cook over low heat until the mixture thickens.
Quarter duckling, serve with the sauce, boiled potatoes, vegetables.

recipes.title: Rabbit with paprika sauce · Králík na paprice
ingredients: 1 rabbit, 4·5 lbs., skinned, cleaned, cut in pieces
6 grains each of whole allspice and black peppercorns
instructions: Rinse, pat dry rabbit pieces. Sprinkle with salt and lard each with bacon strips.
Heat oil in a large pan; add onion and cook until translucent. Add paprika, whole allspice, black peppercorns, thyme, bay leaves and rabbit pieces.
Simmer, covered, for 1·1/2 hours, or until rabbit is tender, adding chicken stock when needed.
Using a slotted spoon, lift rabbit pieces from liquid and place in a casserole.

Stir flour into the liquid and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Add remaining chicken stock and sour cream and cook, stirring as necessary, until sauce is reduced to desired consistency, about 5 minutes. Strain sauce over rabbit. Simmer until heated through.
Serve with gnocchi, dumplings, noodles.

recipes.title: Fried rabbit · Králík smažený
ingredients: 1 rabbit, 4·5 lbs., skinned, cleaned, cut in small serving portions
instructions: Scald rabbit with hot water, pat dry. Pound each piece lightly, sprinkle with salt. Dredge each in flour shaking off excess, dip in mixture of beaten eggs and milk, coat with bread crumbs. Fry in hot oil until golden, about 5 minutes each side. Drain on paper towel. Serve with salad, vegetables, potatoes.

recipes.title: Roast hare (or wild rabbit) · Zajíc pečený
ingredients: Hindquarters of 1 hare, 4·5 lbs., cleaned, membrane removed
3 slices bacon, cut in short strips (1")
instructions: Rinse, pat dry hare. Lard meaty side with bacon strips, sprinkle with salt and pepper. Melt butter in a roasting pan, add onion and the hare. Roast at 350F for 45 minutes, larded side down. Turn hare larded side up and roast 30·40 minutes or until tender. Baste frequently with beef stock and juices from the pan. Cut hare in serving portions. Serve with pan juices, fried potatoes, noodles, vegetables.

recipes.title: Hare in cream sauce · Zajíc na smetaně
ingredients: Hindquarters of 1 hare, 4·5 lbs., cleaned, membrane removed
3 slices bacon cut in short strips
5 grains each of black peppercorn, whole allspice, juniper berries
instructions: Rinse the hare, pat dry. Rub with crushed juniper berries, sprinkle with salt, lard with bacon strips.
Melt butter in a heavy skillet, add onion and vegetables, and sauté over medium heat.
When onion is translucent, add hare and brown evenly on all sides.
Transfer all into a roaster. Add spices and some of the beef stock.
Roast 1 hour at 350F larded side down, then turn hare larded side up and continue roasting until tender, about 1 hour. Baste frequently with pan juices and beef stock.
Remove hare to carving board.

Make sauce by combining pan juices with flour. Simmer 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Add juice of 1 lemon and cream. Simmer a little more. Season to taste with salt, pepper and more lemon juice, if needed. Strain.
To serve, slice hare and place slices on a warmed platter. Pour sauce over top.
Serve remaining sauce in a gravy boat.
Serve with rice, noodles, vegetables.

recipes.title: Marinated hare in wine sauce · Zajíc na černo
ingredients: 5 grains each of black peppercorns and whole allspice
instructions: Place hare in a large crock. Add all dry ingredients, top with cognac, add wine.
Add oil to seal air out. The hare must be submerged in the marinade. Soak hare overnight, or even better 2·3 days.
Remove and wipe dry with a cloth.

Heat butter in a 4 quart top·of·range casserole. Add bacon and onion and cook until soft. Add all spices and lemon rind. Sprinkle hare with salt and vinegar, put into casserole, and brown lightly on all sides.
Reduce heat. Add some of the beef stock.
Cover tightly and simmer 1·1·1/2 hours, or until meat is tender when pierced with a fork. Add beef stock occasionally.
Transfer hare to a heated platter.
Skim off fat from the cooking liquid, stir in the flour and continue cooking to a rich brown. Add the remaining beef stock and the wine.
Cook until sauce thickens. Strain, blend in sugar and cranberry sauce. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Bring to boil, stirring constantly.
Slice hare, pour hot sauce over top.
Serve with noodles, gnocchi, dumplings.

recipes.title: Venison cutlets, or medallions · Srnčí žebírka
yieldTime: Serves 6 – Preparation time: 20 minutes, plus marinating
ingredients: 12 young venison cutlets, or medallions, 3 oz. ea.
instructions: Trim excess fat from the cutlets, pound them lightly, rub with juniper berries, sprinkle with salt and pepper, drizzle with cognac and olive oil. Cover, marinate at least 1 hour.
Meanwhile melt butter in a large skillet, sauté onion and mushrooms. Season with salt and pepper. Reserve.

Drain and wipe the cutlets, reserve marinade. Heat remaining oil in a heavy frying pan, fry venison over high heat, about 3 minutes each side. Remove cutlets, keep them warm. Deglaze pan with marinade. Add chicken broth and sour cream, simmer 5 minutes. Taste for salt and pepper.
Coat the cutlets, or medallions, with the sauce. Garnish with mushrooms, snipped parsley, poached halves of apples, serve with noodles, rice.

recipes.title: Roast pheasant · Bažant pečený
ingredients: 2 slices bacon cut in short strips
instructions: Rinse and wipe the pheasant inside and out. Lard the breast and thighs with bacon strips. Brown the pheasant evenly all around in a frying pan in half of the butter and onion. Preheat oven to 350F. Transfer pheasant, breast down, into an ovenproof deep dish together with the butter and onion from the frying pan. Add salt and pepper. Roast 30·40 minutes, until the top gets reddish. Baste often with the remaining butter and chicken broth. Turn the bird breast side up, continue roasting in the same manner, 40·45 minutes. On the stove top bring the pan juices to boil. Add flour and cook 5 minutes stirring constantly. Add the remaining chicken broth and cook a little more. When the sauce thickens, strain it and pour over pheasant, cut in four portion sizes. Serve with red cabbage, potatoes, cranberries.

recipes.title: Pheasant in cream sauce · Bažant na smetaně
ingredients: 2 slices bacon cut in short strips
instructions: Rinse and wipe the pheasant inside and out. Lard the breast and thighs with bacon strips. Roast pheasant as indicated in “Roast pheasant”. In a saucepan blend pan juices, cream and horseradish. Cook for 5 minutes over medium heat. Add cognac and lemon juice. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Strain.
Pour some gravy over the pheasant cut in 4 portions. Serve remaining gravy separately. Serve with rice, vegetables.

recipes.title: Partridge/Quail · Koroptev/Křepelka
instructions: Rinse quails, pat dry. Sprinkle with salt and pepper inside and outside. Place 1/2 slice bacon inside each. Heat butter in a flameproof casserole, add quails. Roast 40·50 minutes at 350F. Baste often with pan drippings, chicken broth or water. Serve dish straight from the oven with quails cut in halves. Garnish with fresh parsley sprigs, red cabbage, cranberry sauce, poached halves of apples. Serve with rice, lentils.

recipes.title: Baked carp · Kapr pečený
instructions: Arrange carp steaks in a single layer in a well oiled baking pan. Season with caraway seeds, salt and pepper. Bake at 350F 25·30 minutes, or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. In a saucepan heat butter until lightly browned. Pour over fish. Garnish with lemon wedges. Serve with potatoes, vegetables, salad.

recipes.title: Fried carp · Kapr smažený
instructions: Soak fish 30 minutes in lightly salted milk. Dredge each piece in flour, dip in beaten eggs, coat with bread crumbs. Fry in hot oil until golden, about 4 minutes each side. Drain on paper towel. Serve on lettuce lined platter, garnish with lemon wedges and parsley sprigs. Serve with potato salad, green salad, vegetables.

recipes.title: Carp with paprika sauce · Kapr na paprice
ingredients: 3 tablespoons butter and 4 tablespoons flour for the roux
instructions: Melt butter in a large saucepot, add onion and cook until translucent. Add parsley and paprika, simmer 3 minutes. Add the fish and some of the fish broth or water.
Cover and simmer 15·20 minutes.
Using a slotted spatula, lift the carp portions onto a heated platter. For sauce, melt butter in a skillet and stir in flour. Cook and stir until golden.

Add cooking liquid from the carp and some of the fish broth if needed.Cook until sauce thickens. Optional: for a creamier sauce blend in heavy cream. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Strain over fish. Serve with mashed potatoes, rice, tomato salad.

recipes.title: Baked pike with sour cream · Štika pečená se smetanou
ingredients: 1 pike, 4 lbs., cleaned, with head and tail left on
2 bacon slices cut in thin strips
instructions: Sauté onion in butter.

Meanwhile, sprinkle pike with salt, paprika and lemon juice. Lard with strips of bacon. Lay fish in a lightly greased baking pan. Arrange potato slices on sides of fish and up, towards the edge of the pan. Sprinkle some salt over potatoes.
Pour the butter onion mixture over fish. Top with sour cream. Bake at 350F, 30·40 minutes.
Serve with tomato salad, vegetables.

recipes.title: Salmon trout with dill sauce · Pstruh s koprovou omáčkou
ingredients: 6 trouts, 4 lbs., cleaned, with heads and tails left on
instructions: Heat the wine, water, onion, lemon juice, bay leaves and peppercorns. Simmer 10 minutes. Add the trouts and simmer gently for 15 minutes, without boiling.

Drain fish, arrange on a heated serving platter, keep it warm. Strain the broth from the fish, reserve 2 cups for dill sauce. Meanwhile, prepare the sauce. Melt butter in a saucepan, blend in flour, stir and cook until golden. Add onion, parsley, fish broth, vinegar, sugar, salt. Cook, uncovered, until sauce thickens. Strain. Blend in the cream and chopped dill. Heat through, do not boil. Pour hot butter over trouts, garnish with parsley. Hand sauce separately.

recipes.title: Ham and noodles casserole · Šunkové nudle
ingredients: 8 oz. fully cooked ham slices, cut into short strips
instructions: Cook noodles in lightly salted water, drain and splash with cold water. In a bowl cream butter, egg yolks, lemon rind. Combine mixture with noodles and ham. Blend thoroughly. Fold in 3 stiffly beaten egg whites. Put into buttered and bread crumbs coated casserole. Pour the cream evenly over top and bake uncovered at 350F 35·40 minutes or until golden brown on top. Serve straight from oven, with green salad or tomato salad.

recipes.title: Stuffed peppers · Plněné papriky
ingredients: 1 lb. finely ground pork or beef
instructions: Slice stem ends from peppers, remove white fiber and seeds. Drop into boiling salted water, simmer 1 minute. Drain on a sieve or paper towel. Pat dry cavities.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a skillet, add onion and ground meat, sauté 10 minutes, mixing often. Blend in the egg, rice and salt. Spoon mixture into peppers, pressing firmly towards bottom and sides.
Arrange stuffed peppers in a flameproof buttered casserole, pour tomato sauce over all. Simmer, covered, 30·35 minutes. Serve with noodles or gnocchi.

recipes.title: Stuffed cabbage rolls · Plněná kapusta
instructions: Pull off 12 large leaves from the cabbage head. Parboil them in salted water, place each on a napkin and flatten it with rolling pin or hand. Soak roll in milk, squeeze off excess and shred it. In a mixing bowl combine ground meat, shredded roll, 1 chopped onion, minced parsely, marjoram, garlic, salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly and spread evenly on the cabbage leaves. Roll them tightly, fasten each with a string or wooden pick. In a large skillet sauté onion in butter, add the stuffed cabbage rolls, simmer 30·40 minutes, adding occasionally some of the chicken stock. Lift rolls onto a serving dish, sprinkle with juices from the pan, serve with rice or potatoes.

recipes.title: Green cabbage · Hlávkové zelí
instructions: Discard outside leaves from the fresh head of cabbage. Quarter, core, rinse and cut in strips. Scald with boiling water. Drain. Sauté onion in oil until translucent. Add cabbage, salt and caraway seeds. Simmer, turning occasionally, until cabbage is tender but crisp, about 15·20 minutes. Blend in flour, simmer 2·3 minutes. Add vinegar and sugar, simmer 1·2 minutes until thoroughly heated through. Serve with pork roast, meatloaf, smoked pork.

recipes.title: Red cabbage · Červené zelí
ingredients: 1 fresh head of red cabbage, about 2 lbs.
1 large apple, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Remove wilted outside leaves from the head of red cabbage. Quarter, core and rinse it. Cut in strips, scald with hot vinegar. In a skillet combine oil, bacon, onion, caraway seeds and sugar. Sauté mixture until brownned. Add cabbage, thinly sliced apple, dash of salt, cover and simmer 15 minutes, or until cabbage is almost tender. Uncover, let liquid almost dry out, blend in flour and red wine, simmer 5·10 minutes. Cabbage should be tender but crisp. Serve with roast goose, duckling, pork, game.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut · Kyselé zelí
instructions: In a skillet combine oil, onion and flour. Brown mixture lightly. Add sauerkraut, caraway seeds, dash of salt and simmer 15 minutes, or until tender. Add sugar, mix thoroughly, simmer about 5 minutes more. Sauerkraut should be tender but crisp. Taste sweet-sour. Serve with pork roast, roast goose, smoked pork.

recipes.title: Mashed potatoes · Bramborová kaše
instructions: Peel potatoes and cook them in salted water. Drain. While hot mash them thoroughly, adding gradually hot milk and butter. Taste for salt. Serve with roasts, meatloaf, fried chicken.

recipes.title: Gnocchi · Krupicové noky
ingredients: 7 oz. regular cream of wheat, not precooked
instructions: In a bowl cream butter and eggs, add cream of wheat, salt, mix thoroughly. Let it rest 20 minutes.
Using a wet teaspoon, scoop gnocchi into lightly salted boiling water. Cook over medium heat for 10 minutes, uncovered. Remove pan from heat, cover and let stand 5 minutes. Drain.

recipes.title: Country gnocchi · Škubánky
instructions: Parboil potatoes in lightly salted water. Drain some of the water, leaving potatoes barely covered. Stir in flour and simmer over low heat about 10 minutes or until potatoes flake when tested with a fork. Drain excess water, if any, salt the mixture and mash it thoroughly. Mixture will be rather thick.
Meanwhile, brown onion in butter.
Dip a tablespoon in hot butter and scoop gnocchi onto a warmed serving dish. Sprinkle with browned onion and butter. Serve as a side dish with meats, or as a meal.
notes: Alternative – Substitute ground poppy seeds mixed with powdered sugar for browned onion. Sprinkle with hot butter.

recipes.title: Dumplings with croutons · Houskové knedlíky
instructions: Croutons: Cut rolls in 1/2" thick slices, cut each slice in uniform squares, braise lightly in butter. Set aside.

In a bowl combine flour, egg, egg yolk, salt, and club soda. Knead until the dough is smooth and no longer sticks to the bowl. Dough should be of medium consistency, not too thick. Add croutons, mix well. Turn the dough over onto a floured pastry board and form two oblong balls-dumplings. Place them in lightly salted boiling water and boil over medium heat for 25 minutes. While cooking turn them with a spatula.
Remove dumplings to a cutting board and cut each into 1/2 · 3/4" slices. Use a thread or very sharp knife. Brush each slice lightly with melted butter.
Serve with roasts, fowl, game, sauces.
Dumpling slices can be frozen and reheated in double boiler.

recipes.title: Yeast dumplings · Kynuté knedlíky
ingredients: 5 cups coarse flour, Gold Medal Wondra
instructions: Leavening: In a bowl stir fresh yeast and sugar until it dissolves. Add 1/4 cup lukewarm milk and 1/3 cup flour, mix thoroughly into a smooth ball. Dust with flour, set aside to rise, in a warm draft free place. Should double in bulk within 15 minutes.

In a separate bowl combine remaining flour, baking powder, lemon rind, salt. Make a well in center where you put egg yolks and the risen leavening. Mix all, gradually adding the remaining lukewarm milk. Knead until dough is smooth and separates from the bowl. Let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes.

Cut tablespoonsfuls of dough, round them into balls, let them rise on a floured surface for 10 minutes. Drop dumplings into rapidly boiling salted water, boil 5 minutes, turn them around with a spatula and cook another 5 minutes. Drain, pierce each with fork, sprinkle with hot butter.
Optional: Coat with fried bread crumbs. Serve with meats and sauces.

recipes.title: Potato dumplings · Bramborové knedlíky
ingredients: 1 cup cream of wheat, regular, not precooked
instructions: Peel potatoes, cook in salted water, drain. Mash them, add butter, eggs, salt. Mix thoroughly, blend in flour and cream of wheat. Knead until dough is smooth and dry.
Pinch off bits of dough, roll into 2" balls. Cook in lightly salted boiling water 10-12 minutes. Serve immediately.
Serve with roast goose, pork, cabbage, sauerkraut.

recipes.title: Potato salad · Bramborový salát
ingredients: 5 medium potatoes, boiled, cooled, peeled and diced
5 slices ham cut in thin strips
7 pickled cucumbers, peeled, diced, squeezed dry
2 large green apples, Granny Smith, peeled, cored, diced
2/3 cup Hellmann's mayonnaise mixed with 1 tablespoon Dijon mustard
instructions: Place potatoes in a large bowl, sprinkle with vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, pepper. Add onions, ham, apples. Add pickles last, making sure they are squeezed dry. Lightly toss together all ingredients. With a spatula thoroughly but carefully blend in mayonnaise/mustard mixture. Chill to blend flavors, at least several hours. To serve, spoon salad in a bowl lined with lettuce. Serve with roasts, chicken, meatloaf.

recipes.title: Goulash soup · Gulášová polévka
ingredients: 1 lb. beef stew meat cut in 1/2" cubes
2 slices bacon cut in short strips
2 medium potatoes, peeled and cut in 1/2" cubes
1/2 teaspoon each of caraway seeds, marjoram, ground nutmeg
instructions: In a large saucepan combine oil, bacon and onion, brown it lightly. Add paprika, beef, pepper, caraway seeds, marjoram, nutmeg, garlic. Cover and simmer until beef is almost tender, about 45 minutes, stirring occasionally and adding 2-3 tablespoons beef stock, just enough to keep moisture in the pan. Uncover, blend in flour, braise 5 minutes. Add potatoes, beef stock, bring to boiling. Cook over medium/low heat until potatoes and beef are tender, 15-20 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Cream of chicken soup · Krém z kuřat
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter and 3 tablespoons flour for the roux
instructions: Place water, chicken, bones, soup greens, onion, salt in a large saucepan. Bring to boiling. Simmer, covered, 45 minutes or until chicken is tender.
Remove chicken when cool, discard skin and bones, puree chicken meat. Reserve.

In a separate saucepan stir flour into melted butter and cook until bubbly and golden brown. Gradually add the broth from the chicken, bones, allspice and pepper. Cook 10 minutes over medium heat. Strain. Stir in puréed chicken. Lightly beat egg yolk and cream and blend mixture into soup. Season with salt and pepper. Heat through. Do not boil after egg yolk/cream addition.

recipes.title: Tripe soup · Drštková polévka
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon each of marjoram, ground allspice, black pepper, ginger
3 tablespoons butter and 4 tablespoons flour for the roux
instructions: Most supermarkets and butchers sell tripe already cleaned and parboiled, so just rinse it well in cold water. However, if you need to start from scratch, here's how:

Clean tripe well and rinse thoroughly under running cold water. Rub with salt, scald with boiling water, then rinse again under running cold water. Put in a large pot, cover with salted water, and boil covered for 1 hour. Drain. Rinse thoroughly in cold water again. Start with clean salted water and boil tripe until almost tender. 1-2 hours.
Cook tripe with carrots, celery and onion in chicken broth until tripe
and vegetables are tender, 30-40 minutes. Remove tripe and vegetables, reserve the broth.

Melt butter in a saucepan. Stir in flour to make a smooth paste. Cook and stir until golden. Add garlic, paprika, marjoram, allspice, pepper and ginger. Brown mixture lightly. Add the broth, simmer 10 minutes, strain.
Cut tripe in 2" long thin strips, slice vegetables, stir into soup. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Country potato soup · Bramborová polévka
ingredients: 3 medium potatoes, peeled, cut in cubes
1/2 teaspoon each of caraway seeds, and marjoram
1 cup fresh mushrooms, sliced lengthwise, sautéed in butter
instructions: In a large saucepot combine potatoes, salt, caraway seeds, marjoram, water. Cook 20 minutes, or until potatoes are crisp-tender.

Sauté onion and garlic in butter, stir in flour, brown lightly. Add 2 cups cooking liquid from the potatoes. Bring to boiling, cook and stir 5 minutes. Strain mixture into potatoes. Simmer 10 minutes, add mushrooms and parsley. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Milk soup · Mléčná polévka
instructions: Lightly beat egg yolks in one cup milk. Pour remaining milk in a saucepot, add sugar and salt. Set over medium/low heat, bring to boiling, stirring constantly. Blend in yolks/milk mixture, heat through, but do not boil. Serve with toasts or croutons.

recipes.title: Wine soup · Vinná polévka
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan, set over medium heat. Beat at low speed until soup starts to boil. Serve with toasts or crackers.

recipes.title: Beer soup · Pivní polévka
ingredients: dash of cinnamon, ground clove, nutmeg
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan, set over medium heat. Beat at low speed until soup is hot. Must not boil. Serve with French bread.

recipes.title: Bohemian open-faced pastries · České koláčky
ingredients: 1 cup filling or thick fruit preserve
instructions: Leavening: In a bowl stir yeast with 2 teaspoons sugar until dissolved. Add 2/3 cup flour and 1/2 cup lukewarm milk. Knead into a ball. Dust with flour, cover with napkin, let rise in a warm place. It will double in bulk within 20 minutes.
In a separate bowl combine remaining flour and sugar, lemon rind, nutmeg, salt. Place risen leavening in center.
Lightly beat egg yolks and the remaining lukewarm milk, then add it gradually to flour/leavening while mixing thoroughly. Finally add melted lukewarm butter and knead dough until smooth and elastic.
Dust with flour, cover with a napkin and let rise 40 minutes in a warm place.
Punch dough down and turn onto lightly floured pastry board. Break off dough and form balls the size of a walnut. Place them on a greased baking sheet, 4" apart. Let rise 10 minutes.

Press down the center of each ball, using bottom of a small glass or other round object, or with your fingers, so that a higher border will be formed. Brush borders with beaten egg. Spread filling evenly over center wells. Let rise 15 minutes.
(If using butter crumbs filling, brush with melted butter first. This way filling will stick).
Preheat oven to 350F, bake 15 minutes, or until borders are golden brown.
Dust with sugar while warm.

recipes.title: Bohemian muffins · Buchty
ingredients: 4 cups coarse flour, Gold Medal Wondra
4 tablespoons butter for brushing and for baking pan
instructions: Leavening: In a bowl stir yeast with 2 teaspoons sugar until dissolved. Add 2/3 cup flour and 1/2 cup lukewarm milk. Knead into a ball. Dust with flour, cover with a napkin, set aside to rise – in a warm draft free place. It should double in bulk within 15-20 minutes.
In a separate bowl blend remaining flour with sugar, lemon rind and salt. Push to sides making a well in the center. Place risen leavening in the well.

Lightly beat egg yolks and whole egg in remaining lukewarm milk. Add it gradually to flour/leavening mixture, mixing thoroughly. Lastly, add melted lukewarm butter. Knead dough until smooth and no longer sticks to the bowl. Dust with flour, cover with napkin and let it rise 40 minutes.

Turn dough over onto a floured pastry board and roll it out to 1/3" thickness. Cut into 2 × 3" rectangles. Drop filling by teaspoonfuls on narrower side of each rectangle, roll over so that filling will be well covered with the dough. Pinch sides firmly to seal them. Dip each piece in butter, or brush on all sides with melted butter. Arrange them close together in a buttered baking pan. Let them rise 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 350F and bake 25 minutes or until golden on top. Invert 'buchty' onto a wire rack and cool, at least 20 minutes. Separate them carefully and sprinkle with sugar.

recipes.title: Ricotta filling · Tvarohová nádivka
yieldTime: Makes approx. 1 - 1/2 cups - Preparation time: 20 minutes
instructions: In a bowl cream the sugar and the egg yolks. Add ricotta, lemon rind, sponge crumbs, rum and raisins - mix well. The sponge crumbs are added to thicken the filling. You can add a little more or less, to achieve the right consistency. If the filling is not thick enough, is runny, it would run out while baking and jeopardize the good look of the finished product.

recipes.title: Walnuts filling · Ořechová nádivka
yieldTime: Makes approx. 1 - 1/2 cups - Preparation time: 30 minutes
instructions: Pour the maple syrup in a saucepan and bring over medium heat. When hot, but not boiling, remove from heat, add the walnuts, vanilla sugar, lemon rind and heavy cream and as much of the sponge crumbs as needed to thicken the mixture. Mix well.

recipes.title: Apple filling · Jablková nádivka
yieldTime: Makes approx. 1 - 1/2 cups - Preparation time: 30 minutes
instructions: Peel, core and quarter the apples. In a saucepan combine apples and water and simmer until soft. Purée the apples in a bowl, and mix in all remaining ingredients. To attain the desired thickness, add some of the sponge crumbs.

recipes.title: Butter crumb filling · Máslová drobenka
yieldTime: Makes approx. 1 - 1/2 cups - Preparation time: 15 minutes
instructions: In a saucepan melt butter, add flour, sugar and vanilla sugar and stir until the mixture crumbles. Cool.

recipes.title: Poppy seeds filling · Maková nádivka
yieldTime: Makes approx. 1 - 1/2 cups - Preparation time: 20 minutes
ingredients: 1 cup ground or pounded poppy seeds
instructions: In a saucepan combine poppy seeds and milk. Cook over medium/low heat, stirring often, until poppy seeds are mashed, 10-15 minutes. Add all remaining ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Cool.
A thick fruit preserve may also be used to fill "Buchty" and "Koláčky".

recipes.title: “Silver dollars” (miniature plain muffins) · Dukátové buchtičky
ingredients: 4 cups coarse flour, Gold Medal Wondra
4 tablespoons butter for baking pan and brushing
instructions: Prepare dough in the same manner as in Bohemian muffins. Roll it out to 1/3" thickness. Using a cookie cutter or a glass 1" in diameter cut out round cakes and lay them tightly together in a buttered baking pan. Brush sides and top with melted butter. Let rise 30 minutes in a warm place. Preheat oven to 350F, bake 20-25 minutes or until golden brown on top.
Serve warm with vanilla sauce or wine froth.

recipes.title: Vanilla sauce - Vanilková omáčka
instructions: In a saucepan cream egg yolks, sugar mixed with vanilla sugar, corn starch. Gradually add hot milk or cream, stirring constantly. Set over low heat, bring to boiling, stirring steadily until desired thickness is reached. Sauce should be medium thick. Strain, serve warm.

recipes.title: White wine froth · Vinná omáčka
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Set over low heat, beat with a wire whisk or electric mixer at low speed until mixture thickens and foams. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Poppy seed loaf · Makový závin
ingredients: 1 egg yolk to brush the loaf with
instructions: Dissolve the yeast by mixing it with a teaspoon of sugar. Add three tablespoons of flour and 1/4 cup lukewarm milk; knead the leavening into a small ball. Let it rise 20 minutes, it should double in size.

Place the remaining flour in a bowl, add eggs, lemon rind, remaining sugar, salt and milk, mix well. Finally add melted or softened butter. Knead the dough until it becames smooth and dry and no longer sticks to the bowl. Let it rise 30 minutes.

Turn the dough onto a floured pastry board and roll it out into 1/8" thick rectangle. Cover evenly with poppy seed filling and roll it into a long narrow loaf (16-17" long). Place loaf on a greased baking sheet and let rise 10 minutes. Brush with lightly beaten egg yolk and bake 20-25 minutes in 35OF oven. When cooled, cut in 3/4" slices and serve.

recipes.title: Czech doughnuts · Koblihy
ingredients: 1/3 cup sugar mixed with vanilla sugar
instructions: Leavening: In a bowl stir yeast with 2 teaspoons sugar until liquefied. Add 1 cup flour and 3/4 cup milk. Mix thoroughly. Knead into a smooth neat ball. Dust with flour, cover with a napkin and let rise 20 minutes. It should double in bulk.

In a separate bowl cream egg yolks and vanilla sugar. Gradually adding heavy cream beat at low speed until foamy. Blend in remaining flour, salt, rum, orange juice and risen leavening. Mix thoroughly. Knead into a smooth, dry, elastic dough. Let rise 30 minutes.
Punch dough down, turn onto a floured pastry board and roll out to 1/3" thickness.
Using a cookie cutter or a small cup, cut out round cakes, about 2-1/2" in diameter.

Drop fruit preserve by teaspoonfuls in center of half of round cakes. Top each with a plain round cake. Press borders firmly together. Be sure they are well sealed to prevent the filling from leaking out. With a smaller round cutter cut out the final shape of the doughnuts. Put doughnuts on lightly floured board, cover with a large napkin, let rest 20 minutes. Fry in hot oil, starting with top side down, in a covered frying pan. When bottom is golden brown turn them over and finish frying, uncovered. Drain on a sieve or paper towel. When cooled, sprinkle with sugar.

recipes.title: Open-faced doughnuts · Vdolky
instructions: Prepare dough in the same manner as in Czech doughnuts, Roll it out to 1/3" thickness. Cut out 3" round cakes. Let rise 30 minutes, in a warm place.
Just before frying make an indentation with teaspoon or finger in center of each cake. For frying, follow directions in Czech doughnuts recipe.
Cool, sprinkle with sugar.
Optional: Spread jam over each depression, sprinkle with crumbled farmer's cheese, dot with sour cream.
Optional:

recipes.title: Karlsbader biscuits · Karlovarské suchary
yieldTime: Preparation time: 2 hours 30 minutes, plus 30 minutes next day
ingredients: 1 cup sugar mixed with vanilla sugar for dusting
instructions: Leavening: in a bowl stir yeast with 2 teaspoons sugar until liquefied. Add 3/4 cup flour and 3/4 cup lukewarm milk. Mix thoroughly, knead, form a ball. Dust lightly with flour, cover with a napkin. Let rise 30 minutes, or until doubled in bulk.

Place all remaining ingredients and the risen leavening on a floured pastry board, knead with the palms of your hands, until dough feels smooth, dry and elastic. Sprinkle with flour, cover with napkin, let rise 40 minutes.
Punch dough down, shape into a loaf and transfer into a buttered and floured loaf pan. Let rise 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 350F, bake 30 minutes, or until top is golden.
Next day: Cut loaf into 1/3" thick slices. Dredge each slice in sugar mixed with vanilla sugar, shake off excess. Put them on a clean dry baking sheet, brown lightly on both sides in 250-300F oven.
Biscuits keep fresh for many weeks in an airtight tin.

recipes.title: Easter bread · Bochánek
ingredients: 1 egg for brushing, butter for baking tray
instructions: Leavening: In a bowl stir the yeast and 2 teaspoons sugar until the yeast dissolves. Add 1/2 cup flour and one third of the milk and knead it into a ball. Sprinkle with flour and set aside to rise, in a warm, draft free area. It will double in bulk within 20 minutes.

In a separate bowl combine the remaining flour, sugar, salt and lemon rind. Make a well in the center and place the risen leavening, egg yolks and whole egg in it. Gradually adding the remaining milk, mix well. Lastly add raisins and melted butter and knead with a wooden spoon, or with hands, until dough is smooth and no longer sticks to the bowl. Set aside, dust with flour and let rise 30 minutes. Punch dough down, let rise 30 minutes again.

After the dough has risen at the second time, turn it over a floured pastry board and divide in two halves. Shape each into a ball. Place on a baking tray lined with buttered wax paper. Let rise 30 minutes. Brush with lightly beaten egg. With a sharp knife slit the top of each bread cross-wise. Let rise 10 minutes. Preheat oven to 350°F. Sprinkle with slivered almonds and bake 30-35 minutes or until breads are golden brown. Dust with sugar and cool at room temperature.

recipes.title: Easter braid · Velikonoční pomlázka
instructions: Prepare the dough exactly as for Easter braid. After it has risen twice, turn it out onto a floured pastry board and divide in three identical sections. Roll and stretch each section into a rope 25" long. Press together both ends of each rope twist it so that it will be braided and make a loop at the end. Place a raw egg in each loop. Place braids on an oven tray lined with buttered wax paper, let them rise 20 minutes. Brush with lightly beaten egg and bake 30 minutes in 350 F preheated oven.

recipes.title: Christmas loaf · Vánočka
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sugar mixed with vanilla sugar for dusting
1/3 cup slivered almonds to sprinkle over loaf before baking
instructions: Leavening: In a bowl stir yeast and 2 teaspoons sugar until dissolved. Add 1/2 cup flour and 1/3 cup lukewarm milk. Knead into a ball, dust with flour, let rise 20-30 minutes, until doubled in bulk.

In a separate bowl combine remaining flour, sugar, salt, lemon rind. Make a well in center. Put egg yolks and risen leavening in the well. Gradually adding remaining lukewarm milk, mix thoroughly. Add raisins and melted butter, knead dough until smooth, dry and elastic. Dust with flour, let rise 30 minutes.
Punch dough down, let rise again 30 minutes.
Turn dough over onto a lightly floured pastry board, divide in two halves.

Divide one half into 3 identical sections. Form 3 ropes 13" long. Braid them, pinch together both ends. Place on oven tray lined with buttered wax paper. Make a shallow indentation in center lengthwise,
Optional:

then brush depression lightly with a beaten egg white. Divide remaining dough into 5 identical sections. Form 5 ropes 13" long. Braid 3 ropes and place on top of the thicker braid. Again make indentation in center and brush with beaten egg white. Braid last two ropes, place on top of second layer. Press each end firmly together. Let loaf rise 30 minutes. Brush with beaten egg.
Optional: sprinkle with slivered almonds.

Preheat oven to 375F. Bake 10 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350F, bake 20-25 minutes, check with wooden pick for doneness. Dust with sugar mixed with vanilla sugar while hot. Cool at room temperature at least 1 hour. Slice.

recipes.title: Bishop’s bread (fruit cake) · Biskupský chlebíček
ingredients: 1/2 cup diced dried apricots, other dry fruit can substitute
instructions: In a saucepan combine the egg yolks, the egg, sugar and lemon rind and set over medium/low heat. Beat until the mixture is lukewarm. Remove from heat and continue beating until cool and creamy. Fold in the flour mixed with baking powder, dried apricots, almonds, raisins. Lastly, add melted butter. Turn the batter into a buttered oblong loaf pan lined with wax paper. Bake 30 minutes at 350F. Test for doneness with a cake tester or toothpick. Inserting it in the center, it should come out clean. Let stand for 5 minutes before turning the bread out onto a cake rack. Dust lightly with sugar. Cool and slice.
Optional: Spread apricot jelly very thinly over the bread and top with sugar icing. When cooled, or when the icing hardens (approximately 2 hours), slice.

recipes.title: Sugar icing:
instructions: Mix sugar and water well and cover the cake evenly. If the icing is too thick, add water. It should be somewhat thick, not too runny. For variety: replace 3 teaspoons of water with 3 teaspoons of lemon juice, coffee, rum or any other juice to add taste and color. The cake must be warm while frosting it in order to achieve a glossy look. Using hot water or milk you will get a fondant-like look.

recipes.title: Nut bread · Ořechový chlebíček
ingredients: 3/4 cup sponge crumbs, or bread crumbs
butter and flour for baking pan
10 walnut or pecan halves for decorating
instructions: Beat the whole eggs until they are foamy, adding the sugar gradually. Stir in all ingredients, leaving the flour mixed with baking powder to be added last. Turn the batter into a buttered and floured loaf pan and bake at 350F 40-45 minutes, or until the toothpick comes out clean. When done, invert the bread onto a cake rack, cover with icing and decorate with walnut or pecan halves.
Sugar icing: Same as used on fruit cake.
Note:
Instead of icing and decorating with nuts, just dust it with sugar mixed with a pinch of cinnamon.

recipes.title: Cherry cake · Bublanina
ingredients: butter or margarine and flour for baking dish
instructions: Beat two egg whites and half of the sugar until stiff, set aside. In a bowl combine the butter, the egg yolks and the remaining sugar and beat until creamy and fluffy. Add lemon rind, vanilla sugar and milk, mix well. Fold in the beaten egg whites by spoonfuls, mixing gently after each addition. Fold in the flour mixed with baking powder. Pour the batter into a buttered and floured baking dish – fill no more than half full. Spread the cherries evenly over the batter and bake at 375F for 30 minutes, or until golden on top. Remove from oven, cool, cut into squares, dust with sugar.

recipes.title: Poppy seed pie · Makovec
ingredients: 1·1/2 cups ground or pounded poppy seeds
grease and flour for baking dish
instructions: In a bowl combine all dry ingredients, mix them, add the lemon rind and the milk. Mix thoroughly and pour the batter into a greased and floured baking dish. Bake in preheated 350F oven about 45 minutes. Cool, cut into squares and dust with sugar.

recipes.title: Czech apple pie · Jablkový koláč
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sugar mixed with vanilla sugar
3 medium apples, Granny Smith, peeled, cored, thinly sliced or grated
3 tablespoons sugar mixed with 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Blend baking powder and flour. Add sugar, egg yolk, lemon rind, salt, milk and butter. Mix thoroughly and knead until smooth, about 10 minutes.

On a greased oven tray roll dough out to 1/3" thickness, leaving the edges a little higher. Mix apples, raisins, sugar-cinnamon and spread evenly over dough. Bake at 350F, 20-25 minutes, until border is golden brown. Place pie on a wire rack to cool, dust with sugar mixed with vanilla sugar. Cut into squares.
Instead of one oblong pie, you can make two smaller round pies.
Filling:

recipes.title: Potato apple pie · Jablkový koláč bramborový
ingredients: 1/2 cup hazelnuts or walnuts, ground or chopped
3 medium apples, Granny Smith, peeled, thinly sliced parboiled
instructions: Blend baking powder into flour. Add all ingredients and mix thoroughly. Knead about 10 minutes, until dough is smooth and dry. On a floured surface roll dough out to 1/3" thickness, cut in two halves. Place one half in a buttered baking dish, evenly spread apple mixture. Cover with other half of dough. Preheat oven to 375F, bake 30 minutes or until golden on top. Cut in squares, lightly dust with sugar.

recipes.title: Bread and apple baba · Žemlovka
ingredients: 6 hard baked rolls, italian or french, sliced 1/3" thick
3 large apples, Granny Smith type, peeled, thinly sliced
2 tablespoons sugar mixed with 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Beat lightly milk, eggs, sugar, salt. Soak bread slices in the mixture. Squeeze off excess and arrange bread in a single layer in a generously buttered ovenproof casserole. Follow with a layer of apples. Spread raisins and cinnamon/sugar evenly over apples. Top with a layer of bread slices. Preheat oven to 350F. Bake 30-40 minutes until top is golden brown. Dust with sugar. Serve hot or cooled.

recipes.title: Apple strudel · Jablkový závin
instructions: Place the flour on a pastry board and make a well in the center. Pour lukewarm water in the well. Add salt, softened butter and the egg. With the palm of your hands knead all ingredients into a ball. Let it rest in a warm place for 30 minutes.

Turn the dough over a floured cloth napkin, flatten it a little with a rolling pin and brush with melted hot butter. Then stretch it with hands into a thin oblong shape. Cover two thirds with bread crumbs browned in butter.

Peel the apples, slice them thinly and spread them evenly over the bread crumbs. Top with sugar mixed with cinnamon and raisins. Brush the edges of the dough with melted butter. With the help of the napkin roll the dough with the filling into a loaf. Put the loaf on a greased baking sheet and brush it with butter. Bake 30 minutes at 375F. When done, slice it and dust with sugar. May be served warm, or cooled. Can be reheated.

recipes.title: Yellow cake · Bábovka
ingredients: 1 whole egg, 3 egg yolks, 4 egg whites
butter and flour for baking pan
instructions: In a bowl cream the butter, sugar, whole egg, egg yolks, lemon rind and vanilla sugar. Beat at medium speed until fluffy. Add the milk, raisins and half of the flour, mix thoroughly. In the end fold in stiffly whipped egg whites and the remaining flour mixed with baking powder. Pour the batter in a buttered and floured fluted tube pan and bake for one hour at 350F. Test for doneness with a tester or toothpick. Turn the cake out onto a cake rack, dust lightly with powdered sugar, cool and slice.

recipes.title: Fudge Marble cake · Mramorová bábovka
ingredients: butter and flour for baking pan
instructions: In a bowl cream the butter, sugar, egg yolks, vanilla sugar and lemon rind. Beat until fluffy. Add the milk and the flour mixed with baking powder. Fold in the stiffly whipped egg whites. Pour half of the batter in a separate bowl. Dissolve the cocoa powder in water and combine with one of the yellow batter halves. Turn the mixture into a buttered and floured fluted tube pan, alternating the yellow and the brown batter.
Bake at 350F for 1 hour, or until the toothpick comes out clean. Invert the cake onto wire rack, dust with sugar, cool and slice.

recipes.title: Plum dumplings · Švestkové knedlíky
ingredients: 2 lbs. plums, apricots, cherries or other fruits
(1) Sugar mixed with a little cinnamon (2) Ground poppy seeds mixed with sugar (3) Grated farmers cheese (4) Cream or sour cream can substitute the hot butter
instructions: In a bowl cream the butter, the egg, the egg yolk and sugar, using wire whisk or electric mixer at low speed. Add flour and lukewarm milk. Knead the dough until it no longer sticks to the bowl. Turn it over on a floured pastry board and roll it out to 1/2" thickness. Cut in squares 2 × 2". Place one plum, or other fruit pitted or not, in the center of each square. Enclose the dumplings by pressing the four corners firmly together and round them in the palm of your hand. Boil in lightly salted water for 6 - 7 minutes. Drain. Sprinkle with browned bread crumbs, sugar and melted hot butter.
These dumplings can be prepared ahead of time and reheated in double boiler.
Serve warm as a dessert or a meal.

recipes.title: Potato plum dumplings · Švestkové knedlíky bramborové
ingredients: 2 lbs. plums, apricots, cherries or other fruits
instructions: Boil the potatoes, peel and purée them while hot. When cooled add the flour, salt, butter and egg and knead the dough until smooth. Turn the dough over on a floured pastry board and continue as indicated above.
Topping: same as above

recipes.title: Apple, plum, peach, banana fritters (or other fruits of similar consistency) · Ovocné kobližky
recipes.titleEnglish: Apple, plum, peach, banana fritters (or other fruits of similar consistency)
ingredients: 1-1/2 cups oil or butter for frying
1-1/2 cups oil or butter for frying
instructions: In a bowl blend flour, salt, milk, mixing constantly (use wire whisk or electric mixer at low speed). Add egg, rum and sugar. Mix well.
In a bowl thoroughly blend egg yolks and wine. Gradually add flour, salt, sugar and oil. (use wire whisk or electric mixer at low speed). Gently fold in stiffly whipped egg whites.

Peel and core the apples. Cut them in round slices (approx 1/3" thick), dip each in the batter and deep fry until golden brown. Drain on a paper towel, dust with sugar and serve. Or serve with apricot sauce.

In a saucepan combine the wine, lemon rind, apricot preserve and sugar. Set over medium heat and bring to boil stirring constantly. Boil for 1 minute. Add the cornstarch dissolved in water and boil one minute more. Pass the sauce through a sieve. Serve warm with warm desserts and cold with cold desserts.
Peel and pit the plums or peaches. Cut in halves or sections, dip in the batter and deep fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towel, dust with sugar.
Sliced bananas and other fruits may be prepared in the same manner.

recipes.title: Cabbage pockets · Zelné taštičky
instructions: Make stuffing: Sauté onion in oil until translucent. Stir in sugar. Add cabbage, salt and pepper, cook 10-15 minutes, until cabbage is tender. Do not overcook. Properly cooked cabbage should be crisp.
Combine dough ingredients and knead until smooth, for about 10 minutes.

On a floured surface roll dough out to 1/4" thickness. Cut out 2-1/2" squares. Drop a spoonful of cabbage in center of each square. Brush edges with egg white, fold squares to form a triangle. Press edges firmly together.
Boil slowly in lightly salted water for 5 minutes.
Drain, dredge in bread crumbs browned in butter, sprinkle with sugar.

recipes.title: Country pancakes · Lívance
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sugar mixed with 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
1/2 cup each of fruit jam and sour cream
instructions: In a large bowl stir yeast and 2 teaspoons sugar until dissolved. Gradually add lukewarm milk, flour, salt, remaining sugar, nutmeg, and egg yolks. Mix thoroughly, let rise in a warm place 30 minutes or until doubled in bulk. Gently fold in stiffly whipped egg whites. Let rise 15 minutes.

Lightly grease griddle, and set over medium heat. After 4·5 minutes griddle should be hot enough for baking. Pour batter onto griddle by scoopfuls, about 3·1/2" in diameter, leaving at least 1" between cakes. Turn pancakes as they become puffy and full of bubbles on top.
Brush each with melted butter, sprinkle with sugar mixed with cinnamon.
Optional: Spread fruit jam over pancakes and dot with sour cream. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Apple pancakes · Jablkové palačinky
ingredients: 2 large apples, Granny Smith type, peeled, diced
instructions: Cream egg yolks and sugar, using wire whisk or electric mixer at low speed. When mixture becomes foamy, gradually add flour, salt and milk mixing well after each addition.
Blend in apples and stiffly whipped egg whites. Drop by scoopfuls in hot butter and fry on both sides. Roll each pancake, sprinkle with sugar and place on a serving dish.

recipes.title: God’s graces · Boží milosti
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable oil or butter for frying
1/3 cup sugar mixed with vanilla sugar for dusting
instructions: On a lightly floured surface sift together flour, salt, sugar and vanilla sugar. Make a well in the center. Put egg yolks, cream, wine and crumbled butter in the well. Knead, with the palms of your hands, until dough is smooth and shiny. Roll out into a paper-thin sheet. Cut into 2" squares. Make two 1" cuts inside each square. Fry in hot oil or butter on both sides, until lightly golden. Drain on paper towel, sprinkle with sugar mixed with vanilla sugar.

recipes.title: Pretzels, sweet · Preclíčky
instructions: On a floured board sift together flour and sugar, make a well in center. Thoroughly blend all remaining ingredients and place in well. Gradually mixing in flour, knead with the palms of your hands until smooth. Form a neat ball. Let dough rest at least 1 hour in a cool place, or refrigerate overnight. Divide dough into equal pieces, the size of a ping-pong ball. Form pencil-thin strands and shape them into pretzels. Place on a greased cookie sheet, brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with crystal sugar. Bake at 350F 10-12 minutes or until golden.

recipes.title: Nut cake · Ořechový dort
ingredients: 1 cup hazelnuts or walnuts, ground or finely chopped
butter and flour for cake pan
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff, set aside. In a separate bowl cream sugar and egg yolks, adding one at a time and beating well after each addition. Add 1 tablespoon water. Continue beating until light and fluffy, about 10 minutes total. Fold in flour, nuts and stiffly whipped egg whites. Mix thoroughly, pour batter into buttered and floured 9" spring form cake pan. Preheat oven to 350F, bake about 40 minutes or until cake tester or wooden pick comes out clean and cake separates from side of spring form.
When cooled, cut cake horizontally, spread evenly with chocolate or mocca filling, then frost top and sides with the same. Decorate with walnuts or pecan halves or tosted almonds slivers.

recipes.title: Chocolate filling · Čokoládový krém
yieldTime: For 1 cake – Preparation time: 15 minutes, plus refrigeration
instructions: Combine cream and chocolate in a saucepan, set over low heat and bring to boil, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and pour mixture in a clean bowl. Refrigerate at least 3 hours or overnight. Whip with electric mixer at medium speed until smooth and creamy for about 7 minutes.

recipes.title: Mocha filling · Mocca krém
instructions: In a saucepan cream sugar and egg yolks. Add coffee, set over medium heat. Stir constantly until mixture becomes hot. Do not boil. Remove from heat, turn mixture into a clean bowl, let cool. In a bowl cream butter and gradually add the cooled sugar/egg yolks/coffee mixture. Beat until fluffy.

recipes.title: Vanilla horns · Vanilkové rohlíčky
yieldTime: Preparation time: 1 hour 15 minutes, plus refrigeration
ingredients: 2 packages vanilla sugar (1 package into dough, 1 for sprinkling)
4 tablespoons sugar mixed with vanilla sugar
instructions: On a floured pastry board knead all ingredients into a ball. Use palms of your hands, not fingers, so that dough will not crumble. Dough is ready when smooth and no longer sticks to the board. Refrigerate 1 hour, or overnight as it will be easier to work with. Shape tiny horns the size of your little finger or smaller, according to your preference and patience. A small grinder is available in some speciality stores, which makes them all equal in size and is faster than the "manual method". Place horns on a clean dry cookie sheet, 1" apart. Preheat oven to 325F, bake 15-20 minutes, until pale golden. Remove from oven and let stand 5 minutes. While hot, sprinkle with sugar mixed with vanilla sugar. When cooled remove carefully from cookie sheet. They keep for many weeks in an airtight tin.

recipes.title: Almond snow-balls · Kostrby
ingredients: Butter and flour for cookie sheet
instructions: Beat egg whites and sugar in a bain-marie, until the mixture thickens. Remove from heat, stir in almonds. Drop by teaspoonfuls on a buttered and floured cookie sheet 1\frac{1}{2} " apart. Bake 14 minutes at 325F. Snow-balls should puff-up and be pale-golden. Remove carefully from cookie sheet.
Let snow-balls dry thoroughly, at least 2 hours, in a warm oven under 200F.
Store in a dry place.

recipes.title: Butter rounds · Máslová kolečka
ingredients: 1/3 cup sugar mixed with 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar
red raspberry or red currant preserve
instructions: On a floured pastry board knead all ingredients into a ball using the palms of your hands, not the fingers. The dough will be smooth and will not crumble. You can let it rest for a few hours, overnight or more. You can use it right away also.

With a roller pin roll the dough out as thin as possible. (1/8"). Cut it into 1-1/4" round cakes, using a cookie cutter or a glass. Separate half of the round cakes and cut out a small round hole in the center, the size of a thimble. Use a cookie cutter or a thimble. Place the round cakes on a clean, dry cookie sheet and bake at 350F for 15 minutes, or until they are pink/golden. Remove from oven and cool. Before serving put 1/2 teaspoon of red raspberry or red currant seedless preserve in the center of each plain round, top it with one "holed" round. The red color is important for the look of the cookies and the sour flavor of raspberry or currant compliments them well. Unfilled cookies can be stored for weeks in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Truffles · Lanýže
instructions: Pour the cream in a saucepan and set over medium heat. When hot, but not boiling, add sugar, vanilla sugar and the ground nuts. Stirring steadily, boil until the mixture stiffens and separates from the pan. Remove from heat. Let it cool or refrigerate overnight. Next day: Make little balls, dip each in egg white and dredge in grated chocolate. Let the "truffles" dry for 10 minutes and place them in petit-four holders.
